name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: State scheme providing monthly financial assistance to eligible women residents of Maharashtra.
eligibility: Women aged 21-65 residing in Maharashtra, meeting income and other criteria as notified.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance credited via DBT to eligible women.
application_steps: Register on the Ladki Bahin portal or Narishakti Doot app.
Submit and note the application number.
Track approval and DBT credit status.
processing_time: Verification-dependent; benefits via DBT after approval.
office_locator_info: Anganwadi centres, Setu, CSC, ward offices.
ai_summary: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana is a state government service under Women and Child Development Department in the Welfare category, available both.
ai_explanation: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana is State scheme providing monthly financial assistance to eligible women residents of Maharashtra. Eligibility: Women aged 21-65 residing in Maharashtra, meeting income and other criteria as notified.. Benefits: Monthly financial assistance credited via DBT to eligible women.. You can apply both via https://ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in. Processing time is typically Verification-dependent; benefits via DBT after approval. and fees are Free..
